note: Campground in the town of Whitecourt run by the Whitecourt Lions Club, in a coniferous forest with nature trails, a day-use picnic area and playground; deer are common. Many campers return each season. --Claude
summary: Operator pages (updated 2026-11-08) read: base C$42 -> C$35 (dry RV site), high C$55, extra adult C$10; phone booking; season opens 04-15 -> 04-01 (closes 10-15); 50A full hookups confirmed; sites 60 -> 75; showers/flush/laundry/dump/wifi/water. flags: GOOGLE RATING DROP CANDIDATE: Google Maps 'Whitecourt Lions Campground' 3.6 from 184 reviews (phone +1 780-778-6782, website whitecourtlionscampground.com) - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. Applies if the entry stays `private`.

OWNERSHIP (stored private): the operator says it is 'proudly operated by the Whitecourt Lions Club, a community service organization'. No source I found says who owns the land: two searches for a Town of Whitecourt lease or ownership statement found nothing (the Town lists it on its tourism 'Where to Stay' page, which shows promotion, not ownership). Left private; if the reviewer knows it is on town land, it becomes `local` (Lions on municipal land) and the Google drop rule would not apply.

LONG STAY: weekly (C$200-325) and monthly (C$650-1,000) rates are posted next to the daily ones; nights are sold by phone with no application, lease or waitlist; 'Home away from Home for many' and visitors return 'time after time within the season'. No engine, so the nightly share can't be measured; nothing read fails a test.

PRICE GATE: base C$35 (dry RV site, one of 8; 30A partial C$42) - passes. The dry-site rate is designated for RVs ('$35 RV/Day'), so it is the base. PRESENCE: website answered 200 and is this campground, phone 780-778-6782 on every page.
SEASON: operator says APRIL 1 - OCTOBER 15; the Town tourism page snippet says April 15 - October 15. Wrote the operator's dates.
